description: Assessment of Building Resiliency in Tornadoes Considering Transient Internal Pressure Effects is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Delong Zuo, Texas Tech University (ttu.edu). Buildings that serve as essential facilities to communities must remain operational after natural disasters, including tornadoes, to providevital services and reduce recovery time. A frequent cause for building failures in tornadoes has been the sudden occurrence of largeopenings in the building envelope, such as when overhead vehicular doors are breached due to debris impact. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: low-rise building,  tornado-like vortex,  internal pressure,  transient effect. Published 2026-04-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
